values.binNote: Bin's BaseDamage [150/225/300/375/450], ADRatio 2, APRatio 1.5 are totals over 5 ticks per CarpetBomb#MaximumDamage; wiki's per-tick numbers equal these divided by 5 (30/45/60/75/90 base, 0.4 AD, 0.3 AP).
TicksPerSecond=2 corresponds to an interval of 0.5s (1/2).
No bin field corresponds to the lingering-damage duration; it is only described in the wiki text.

mechanics.claim: Gatling Gun (E) can be cast during Valkyrie's dash, allowing its damage to overlap with the dash.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Gatling Gun|Corki}} can be cast during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Enemies who leave a fire patch continue to take damage for 1 more second (lingering), separate from the 2.5s patch duration.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within the patches are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lingering for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Valkyrie drops up to 3 blazing patches along Corki's dash path depending on distance traveled.
mechanics.quote: drops bombs that leave up to 3 blazing patches along his path, depending on the distance traveled
